question: Will US Treasury 10-year yield be above 4.5% by end of 2026?

market_info.title: Will the yield of 10-year U.S. treasury notes be above 4.74 on Dec 31, 2026?
market_info.description: If the 10Y US Treasury Yield is above 4.74% on Dec 31, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes. The market will expire at the sooner of the first 7:00 PM ET following the data release for Dec 31, 2026, or one week following Dec 31, 2026.
